coordinate_convention: header RA_OBJ/DEC_OBJ as supplied; frame not independently established
interpretation_limit: -3.0 robust-MAD threshold from the campaign's sign-flip calibration; entries overlap across recipes and are not independent events.

systematics_model.method: residual autocorrelation integral to first zero crossing
systematics_model.caveat: A correlated systematic repeating on the event timescale can mimic a dip; this model constrains noise, it does not prove astrophysical origin.
